description: Changes to system configurations are not tracked, reviewed, or controlled through a formal change management process. This signal indicates that configuration modifications may occur without documentation, approval, or the ability to audit who made changes and when.
applicability: Applicable to any system where configuration changes occur including infrastructure, applications, network devices, and cloud resources. Includes version control for infrastructure-as-code, change approval workflows, and configuration drift detection.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of change management procedures, version control usage for configurations, configuration drift detection tools, and audit trails of system modifications.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
